news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Earnings have declined by 11% per year over the past 5 years. Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.7% average weekly change). Profit margins are more than 30% low

news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 3.5% Last year net profit margin: 5.2% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.71 (vs ₹3.39 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.71 (down from ₹3.39 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹832.1m (down 2.5% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹27.0m (down 49% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.2% (down from 6.2% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 19% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 26% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.93 (vs ₹2.58 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.93 (down from ₹2.58 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹942.3m (up 14% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹30.5m (down 31% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.2% (down from 5.4% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 21% per year whereas the company’s share price has fallen by 19% per year.
